summary: Fabrinet filed an 8-K reporting routine credit facility amendments and a new term loan. The Thai subsidiary borrowed THB 2.50 billion (~$75.0M) under a Facility Agreement amended to increase capacity to THB 2.61 billion (~$78.3M) and $100M, extending the drawdown to 2044. Proceeds fund capital expenditures with standard covenants and events of default. No special situation; ordinary financing disclosure.
